newsitem.title: USA: Michaels Stores expects Q3 operating loss.
newsitem.headline: Michaels Stores expects Q3 operating loss.

text.p: Michaels Stores Inc said Wednesday it plans to post a charge of between $1.00 and $1.50 per share in the third quarter and expects to post an operating loss during that period.
The charge is related to the planned closings of four stores in early 1997 as well as the costs associated with eliminating its home decor products.
Michaels Stores said the charge will put it in "technical violation" of its bank covenant. It is in the midst of discussions with its lead bank to seek appropriate waivers.
The company plans to announce its third quarter earnings on November 20.
In last year's third quarter, the company reported net income of $3.01 million, or $0.14 per share, on revenues of $312.7 million.
